fixes.explanation: Hormah, baker! After the LORD heard Israel's plea and delivered up the Canaanites, the text says "so they named the place Hormah." Israel gave that spot a name it would carry from then on. That's one way to make sure nobody forgets what happened there. I put my name on my cookie planet the same way, though mine was carved into a handle by the Millers.

problems.problem: The explanation feels flat and repetitive: it quotes the name, then simply repeats that Hormah is the name Israel gave the place.
